reason: When my 4 PM samosas arrive crisp and piping hot, the last thing I want is a squeeze tube squirting clear watery liquid over them before the paste comes out. I prefer sticking to the halwai's fresh chutney or our trusted Ching's and Veeba sauces.
objection: Liquid syneresis inside squeeze tubes causing watery discharge that ruins hot snacks, along with unproven flavour authenticity.
would_change_my_mind: Free sample demonstrating thick, non-separating consistency with genuine street-style chaat taste.
